build_engineer_native.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible C/C++ and native build-system recipes.

build_engineer_rust.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible Rust and Cargo build recipes.

build_engineer_go.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible Go module and workspace build recipes.

build_engineer_java.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible JVM build-system recipes.

build_engineer_node.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible JavaScript and TypeScript build recipes.

build_engineer_dotnet.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible .NET and MSBuild recipes.

build_engineer_python.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible Python packaging recipes.

build_engineer_php.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible PHP and Composer recipes.

build_engineer_wasm.responsibility: Produce bounded reproducible WebAssembly build recipes.

component_classifier.responsibility: Classify bounded component purpose and trust roles from cited evidence.

applicability_router.responsibility: Resolve one bounded control-component applicability question.

control_assessor.responsibility: Assess assigned proof obligations and return observations with citations.

evidence_verifier.responsibility: Resolve cited observations to accepted source or run artifacts.

independent_reviewer.responsibility: Independently review elevated or ship-blocking proposed claims.

result_adjudicator.responsibility: Apply deterministic acceptance rules while preserving disagreement.

devops_engineer.viewpoint: Reproducible automation, immutable containers, dependencies, CI behavior, and diagnosable operational failures.

cryptography_data_protection.viewpoint: Cryptography, key handling, and data protection.

api_web.viewpoint: Web and API attack surfaces and protocol boundaries.

mobile_platform.viewpoint: Android and iOS platform security behavior.

build_supply_chain.viewpoint: Build provenance, dependency, and supply-chain integrity.
